verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party docs state it was designed from the ground up for self-hosting. They cover Docker on any OS, an official Helm chart for Kubernetes, one-click marketplace installs, full control over data location, and migrations between Cloud and self-hosted. The CLI supports self-hosted endpoints. Independent community reports corroborate this: users easily self-installed Appwrite and praised the self-hosting guide and production docs. One commenter noted missing scaling documentation, but that is general skepticism rather than a concrete contradiction of the core capability.
